source_basis: NCCP 00372 v 6 and current EMA Vargatef product information; combination and continuation risks are distinguished.

risks.label: Diarrhoea, nausea and vomiting
risks.detail: Diarrhoea can cause dehydration and electrolyte problems; follow the early action plan and seek advice promptly.

risks.label: Liver injury
risks.detail: Blood tests can detect liver changes before symptoms. Serious liver injury can occur; yellow skin/eyes or dark urine requires advice.

risks.label: Bleeding and blood clots
risks.detail: Serious bleeding, clots and cardiovascular events can occur. Coughing blood, chest pain or sudden breathlessness requires urgent assessment.

risks.label: Infection with docetaxel combination
risks.detail: Combined treatment increases neutropenic complications. Fever or sudden illness needs immediate oncology advice. The tablet-only phase has a different plan.

risks.label: Bowel perforation or ischaemic colitis
risks.detail: Rare but serious bowel complications can occur. Severe abdominal pain or bloody stools needs urgent assessment.

risks.label: Kidney injury / protein in urine
risks.detail: Kidney injury and protein loss can occur; report swelling or reduced urine and attend tests.

risks.label: Poor wound healing
risks.detail: Tell oncology before surgery or procedures; treatment timing depends on adequate healing.

risks.label: Rare neurological syndrome (PRES)
risks.detail: Severe headache, vision change, confusion or seizures needs urgent help.

risks.label: Pregnancy, breastfeeding and fertility
risks.detail: Discuss fertility and pregnancy prevention. Avoid pregnancy during treatment and for at least 3 months after nintedanib; follow longer partner-medicine advice. Do not breastfeed during treatment. Vomiting/diarrhoea may affect oral contraception.
